第一千一百零一章 默默淘汰（第1页）
默默淘汰（默默淘汰（第22页）“让诸位见笑了。”与鼠标简单的寒暄一句后，武书正色道，“有关心魔一事，本少主是这么认为。心魔宛如人性，你在意与不在意它，它都在，你越畏惧它，它越会在你最不想见到它的时候出现。那么，如何做才能够破除心魔呢？此事说简单也简单，说不简单也不简单。”停顿了下，武书又是道，“依旧如人性，想必在场的诸位皆因为过某件事或某个人尴尬或后悔过，而不论是这些事情或这些人过去多久，每每回想起来，那尴尬或后悔的感觉都会油然而生。正如，本少主先前所言，身为开慧生灵之一，这世间生灵的丑陋和美好，你我的身上都是同时拥有的。而竟然很多已经发生的事情已经不能再改变，那么，你我为何不能默默的将那些令自己感到尴尬或后悔的事情反复剥开看呢？毕竟，此过程是在正视过去，同时也是在正视自我。而最为重要的是，在本少主看来，那些过往的确无法改变，但你我却可以依靠这些过往来修正未来。所谓，心魔亦是如此！先要敢于面对心魔，在确定了心魔是什么的时候，只要你我敢于将过往那些滋生心魔的土壤捏碎，于破碎中以大毅力重塑自我。所谓心魔，不过是助你我实力境界再进一步的资粮罢了。”说到此处，至圣仙师那高大伟岸的模糊身姿也是从武书的脑海中一闪而过，武书立马补声道，“正如至圣仙师说过，未曾破碎过，何谈完整过。”然而，也不知道，是不是这次问道，武书说的话太多，在场的很多天骄还需要好好回味回味，又或者是说，武书的这些话，对于在场的很多天骄来说，完全是废话。总之，自二次悟道开始以来，尚未出现宿命的声音。在一阵思绪飞转后，武书又是将悟道石招到面前道，“事关冲击三次悟道境，本少主是这么认为的。竟然，悟道石力形态可分为涟漪形态和震荡波形态，而不论是涟漪全形态，还是震荡波全形态，想要依靠它们进一步蜕变都是非常困难的。那么，诸位同辈先通过先易后难的方式，将这两种力形态进一步完整化。如涟漪形态，先以单一对称的涟漪形态进行短暂的修炼，待对这种单一对称的涟漪形态彻底熟悉后，再逐渐加大涟漪形态的完整性。”说话间，武书也是一指点出，两道围绕其食指且向外扩散完全一致的对称涟漪也是呈现。一块悟道石同时在两个水面上激荡起的涟漪画面就这般真切的呈现在众天骄面前，一时间，在场的很多天骄都出现了先天战体再次要突破瓶颈的感觉。而在察觉到悟道城中出现的气息变化，武书也算是明白了一个道理。因先天天资占尽优势，在场的很多天骄早已经习惯了这些先天优势，与他们论道，说的再多再好，也不如实战来的效果快。“罢了！”“以后论道，还是以实战为主吧？”这到了二次论道最后，武书也是领悟出了这么一句心得。

Chapter 1,101 Silently Eliminated (Page 1)
Silent Elimination (Silent Elimination (Page 22) "Make everyone laugh." After a brief greeting with Mouse, Wu Shu said seriously, "As for the matter of inner demons, this is what I think. Inner demons are like human nature. Whether you care about them or not, they are there. The more you fear them, the more they will appear when you least want to see them. So, how can we get rid of inner demons? This matter is easy to say, and it is not easy to say. Shan." After a pause, Wu Shu continued, "Like human nature, everyone here must have been embarrassed or regretted by something or someone. No matter how long it has been, the feeling of embarrassment or regret will arise spontaneously when you think about it. As this young master said before, as one of the enlightened beings, you and I both have the same ugliness and beauty. Many things that have happened can no longer be changed, so why can't you and I silently peel back the things that make us feel embarrassed or regretful? After all, this process is to face the past, and the most important thing is that in my opinion, the past cannot be changed, but you and I can rely on the past to correct the future. The same is true for inner demons! In the face of the inner demons, when we have determined what the inner demons are, as long as you and I dare to crush the soil that breeds the inner demons in the past, and rebuild ourselves with great perseverance, the so-called inner demons are just the resources to help you and I further our level of strength." At this point, the tall and majestic figure of the Supreme Immortal Master also flashed through Wu Shu's mind, and Wu Shu immediately added, "As the Supreme Immortal Master said, it has never been broken. , how can we talk about it being complete." However, I don't know if this time I asked, Wu Shu said too much, and many geniuses present still need to reflect on it, or, for many geniuses present, these words of Wu Shu are completely nonsense. In short, since the beginning of the second enlightenment, the voice of fate has not appeared. After a while of thoughts, Wu Shu called the enlightenment stone in front of him and said, "It is about the third impact. Enlightenment state, this is what I think. It turns out that the form of Enlightenment Stone can be divided into ripple form and shock wave form, and it is very difficult to rely on them for further transformation, whether it is the full ripple form or the full shock wave form. So, my peers should first complete the two forms of force by first practicing the easy and then the difficult ones, such as the ripple form. After you are thoroughly familiar with this single symmetrical ripple shape, you can gradually increase the completeness of the ripple shape." As he spoke, Wu Shu also pointed out that two symmetrical ripples surrounding his index finger and spreading outward were also present. The image of a piece of enlightenment stone rippling on two water surfaces at the same time was so vividly presented in front of all the geniuses. For a while, many geniuses present had innate battle bodies that wanted to break through the bottleneck again. Feeling. After noticing the changes in the aura in Wu Dao City, Wu Shu also understood a truth. Because of their innate talents, many geniuses present were already accustomed to these innate advantages. No matter how much they talked about Tao, the effect would not be as fast as actual combat. "That's it!" "In the future, we should focus on practical combat, right?" At the end of the second Tao discussion, Wu Shu also realized this.
